correctness.rationale: The symmetry reduction to four distance classes is exact and the full recurrence was rebuilt. For every integer n>=6, scalar RK4 positivity makes diagonal entries positive; the distance-two quadratic has strictly negative discriminant; and 3AC-B² has an all-positive shifted polynomial certificate, making the distance-one cubic strictly decreasing with one positive zero. Distance-three entries have the linear sign threshold 2/(3n-4). An exact Bernstein negative certificate through n=33 and an all-positive shifted expansion from n=34 prove which coefficient fails first. Complete matrices for n=6 through 12 were independently reconstructed using integer adjacency, agreeing at 2100 exactly rational transition entries. Boundaries and irreversibility of sign loss follow from the global signs; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is the first natural diameter-three Johnson/Bernoulli–Laplace exchange family, beyond the strongly regular rank-two case. For every n>=6 the theorem computes the exact completed fourth-order diffusion positivity horizon, which is mathematically motivated by preserving nonnegative population/probability vectors and exceeds Euler. The sharp n=34 switch between graph-distance-three and adjacent failure supplies new structural information and a reproducible benchmark, not an arbitrary numerical slice or restatement of general SSP theory.
